timing_source: animatic/animatic-data.json aligned words; existing Scene11 boundaries

shots.title: Shrink inside habitat
shots.starting_frame: Full-size established green reptile fully inside a spacious concrete-and-steel zoo habitat. Camera inside enclosure; deep habitat visible, not a small cage. Low fixed camera with wall seams, service door and large rock providing stable scale. Feet grounded and whole body clear of bars.
shots.choreography: Begin shrinking on shrink3401; finish down3420. Body reduces coherently while room and camera stay fixed. End tiny and moving toward perimeter.
shots.reference_brief: New full-size start reference; retain established reptile design, not pose or cage geometry from ANCH-011-A.

shots.title: Fit through and escape
shots.starting_frame: Low exterior view of SAME large habitat boundary. Tiny reptile starts wholly inside, just behind one clear gap between widely spaced bars, with sill and ground plane readable. No body/bar intersection.
shots.choreography: On fit, walk through clear gap, lift feet over low sill, plant on exterior pavement; then tiny defiant snarl for just as mean. Size remains constant.
shots.reference_brief: New tiny-creature start reference BEFORE crossing; align direction and facility materials with shot A.

shots.title: Growth begins inside habitat
shots.starting_frame: Interior of a spacious planted insect habitat with tall steel-mesh roof, concrete base and overhead service structure. Established copper/green-gold insect at normal size, fully contained; one hero insect dominates.
shots.choreography: On Grow up, rise and expand rapidly; legs brace against ground, antennae/head approach roof. No breach yet. Cut as scale change becomes unmistakable.
shots.reference_brief: New intact enclosure interior start; identity from existing insect references, not old miniature cage.

shots.title: Outgrow and breach
shots.starting_frame: Exterior low wide view of same facility, roof and beams still intact but beginning to bow. Enlarging insect visible beneath roof, not already outside. Provide headroom above enclosure.
shots.choreography: On ten times, continue enlargement and break mesh/roof outward. Creature rises above structure; debris drops; hold clear enormous silhouette through or more.
shots.reference_brief: New exterior PRE-breach starting image. Match enclosure bay geometry/materials and insect orientation with A.

shots.title: Dissolve and approach lock
shots.starting_frame: Established translucent lavender space-octopus Cyclops with ONE oversized eye and amber/turquoise organoids, fully intact inside dry exobiology habitat facing closed steel door.
shots.choreography: On Change to smoke, silhouette unravels into vapor; by drift through anything a narrow stream travels toward and starts entering inner keyhole. Leave most passage for reverse angle.
shots.reference_brief: SCN-007-exobiology-v003 identity. No two-eyed ghost. New interior frame before dissolution.

shots.title: Emerge through keyhole
shots.starting_frame: Exterior reverse view of same CLOSED steel door. Brass keyhole at same physical height; empty exterior with only first faint wisp at aperture. Camera close enough for opening to read.
shots.choreography: Lavender vapor with amber/turquoise organoid sparks emerges and reforms the SAME ONE-EYED land-octopus Cyclops mantle and arms outside; steel door stays shut.
shots.reference_brief: Exterior reverse angle, faint gaseous wisp only at start. Match cyclops identity during emergence.
